trade_sign_definition: sign(quantity_close-quantity_open), estimated quantities from prior V/P; nonzero known changes only, zero changes separately counted and excluded
lag_alignment: same current trade_sign * exact previous fund-interval issuer NetSentiment
future_target_definition: current interval end_date + calendar DateOffset(months=h); not 30*h days
price_lookup: Same exact ISIN/SECID/BOARDID; last valid quote not after target and not older than 7 days; future quote date strictly greater than current end_date; both normalized RUB prices. For unheld closing position, exact opening identity may source current-end asof market-price fallback, never zero.
price_return: future_price_rub / p0_price_rub - 1; clean price only, excludes coupon/dividend/reinvestment/transaction expenses, no substitution for total return
cash_return: RUONIA accumulated index at future_target_date / RUONIA accumulated index at origin end_date - 1
rf_index_missing_policy: Exact daily index endpoints required; otherwise NA, no rate extrapolation/zero fill
core_H3_limitation: No fund series meets accepted 36 past monthly returns within 60 months plus 1-3 future months; NAV growth is not a fund return. This supplementary position-level DAR is not fund alpha or original NTS.
benchmark_interpretation: Cash-excess gross price performance, not a risk-matched market benchmark or factor alpha
cutoff_policy: Quantiles fixed once on original nonindex macro-complete continuing Q0>0,Q1>0, before conditional zero entries; not recalculated after group/support/lag filters. Exclude continuing Y strictly above cutoff, retain ties, all certified +100 entries and all -100 exits.
common_sample_policy: At each cutoff/mask/horizon use identical eligible future outcome plus lag-complete ordered rows in contemporaneous-only and contemporaneous-plus-lag variants
inference: Unadjusted two-sided native current/lag p; full-covariance joint chi-square2 and coefficient sum as supplementary tests
invalid_covariance_policy: Required target absorbed or rank-deficient=>NOT_ESTIMABLE. Nonpositive/nonfinite contrast variance=>UNDEFINED, never p=1 or covariance clipping.
interpretation: Exploratory supplementary mechanism using quantity-direction/news alignment and later cash-excess price movement. Not actual trade PnL, fund alpha, fund skill or proof of slow price incorporation.
outcome_trim_policy: Scenario-specific absolute DAR upper quantile by horizon, calibrated once on unique exact ISIN/SECID/BOARDID/origin/target windows with eligible nonzero quantity changes in the already-Q99 baseline, before additional quantity trims, fund focus, support or lag filters. Strict greater-than excluded, equality retained. Absolute-outcome filtering can remove entry/exit rows too, counted separately from quantity trimming.
raw_scenario_interpretation: Q99_RAW preserves unadjusted corporate-action price jumps only as diagnostic, not an economically valid investment-return estimate.

known_corporate_action_limitation.event: 5000 old shares consolidated into 1 share in July 2024
known_corporate_action_limitation.limitation: Raw quotes and estimated quantities are not comprehensively corporate-action-adjusted; trimming extreme future DAR is not a full correction to current quantity changes/trade direction.
